#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

int ncr(int n, int r) {
    if (r > n) return 0;
    int res = 1;
    for (int j = n; j > n - r; j--) res *= j;
    for (int j = 2; j <= r; j++) res /= j;
    return res;
}

double prob(int n, int x) {
    int a = ncr(x, 3) * ncr(n - x, 0);
    int b = ncr(x, 2) * ncr(n - x, 1);
    int c = ncr(x, 1) * ncr(n - x, 2);
    return ((3.0 / 6) * c + a + b) / ncr(n, 3);
}

int main() {
    int n;
    double p;
    cin >> n >> p;
    int i;
    for (i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        if (prob(n, i) >= p) break;
    }
    cout << i << endl;
    return 0;
}
